lines.zh: 头顶的菌盖一晃一晃，我走着。
lines.en: The mushroom cap on my head bobs as I walk.

lines.zh: 我用爪子刨土，边走边嗅。
lines.en: I scratch the soil and sniff as I go.

lines.zh: 孢子落在身后，像一层白粉。
lines.en: Spores drift behind me like white dust.
Dew still clings to my cap.
I pick my way between the mycelium.
One cluck and my cap wobbles.

lines.zh: 这岛上全是蘑菇，我走得自在。
lines.en: The whole island is mushrooms; I walk easy.

lines.zh: 我跳过一个褐色的菌柄。
lines.en: I hop over a brown mushroom stem.

lines.zh: 脚下松软，我每一步都陷一点。
lines.en: The ground gives a little under each step.

lines.zh: 我停下来，又啄了一口土。
lines.en: I stop and take another beakful of soil.

lines.zh: 菌盖投下的影子跟着我。
lines.en: My cap's shadow follows along under me.
The flock is gathered under a toadstool.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈子走，越走越远。
lines.en: I wander in a circle, drifting farther.
There's a purplish tint to my neck.

lines.zh: 我走进菌丛，只露出个盖。
lines.en: I walk into the mushrooms until only my cap shows.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了一块干菌，声音很脆。
lines.en: I step on a dry mushroom and it snaps.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，菌盖罩住半个身子。
lines.en: I squat, and my cap covers half of me.
Spores drift slowly in the light.
Head tilted, I hold perfectly still.

lines.zh: 菌盖边沿有点干了，我不管。
lines.en: The cap's edge is drying; I don't mind.
It's damp here — just right for me.
I'm waiting for a bug to crawl close.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖羽毛，孢子飞起来。
lines.en: I shake and a puff of spores rises.
My cluck sounds muffled among the mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己脚边的菌丝。
lines.en: I stare at the mycelium by my feet.
My cap feels faintly warm.

lines.zh: 地上是一层厚厚的菌毯。
lines.en: A thick carpet of fungus covers the ground.
I lift a wing and let it down.
Nothing much to fear on this island.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋缩到翅膀底下。
lines.en: I tuck my head beneath my wing.

lines.zh: 风一动，孢子就绕着我打转。
lines.en: When the wind stirs, spores circle around me.

lines.zh: 孢子呛了我一下，我打了个喷嚏。
lines.en: A spore tickles my nose and I sneeze.
You're looking at my cap, aren't you?

lines.zh: 我侧过头，正好对上你的眼。
lines.en: I turn my head right into your line of sight.

lines.zh: 生面孔，蘑菇岛很少有客。
lines.en: A new face — the mushroom island gets few.

lines.zh: 我歪头，菌盖跟着倾了一点。
lines.en: I tilt my head and the cap tips with it.
You've stepped on three stems already.
I inch closer, then stop.

lines.zh: 咯咯一声，是问你从哪来。
lines.en: A cluck — asking where you came from.
My cap isn't big; don't pick it.
You don't look like a mushroom eater.

lines.zh: 我抬头，露水甩在你鞋上。
lines.en: I look up and dew flicks onto your boots.

lines.zh: 我往前半步，孢子飘过去。
lines.en: I step in and spores drift toward you.

lines.zh: 你的影子让我以为天阴了。
lines.en: Your shadow made me think it clouded over.
I shriek and my cap lurches sideways.
All my spores puff out at once.
I hop away, flapping.
A chunk of my cap's rim is gone.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，蹲在菌丛里。
lines.en: I shrink down among the mushrooms.
Blood mixed with spores is sticky.
My calls break into short bursts.

lines.zh: 我歪着身子，扑腾着挪了两步。
lines.en: Crooked, I flap and shuffle two steps.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，我的爪子还抓得住地。
lines.en: It hurts, but my claws still grip the ground.
My cap trembles faintly.

lines.zh: 有虫子味，我耳朵都竖了。
lines.en: A bug smell — my ears both go up.

lines.zh: 你手里是谷子还是种子？
lines.en: Is that grain or seeds?
I trot over, cap wagging.
Scatter a little and I'll come.

lines.zh: 我啄了你的鞋，不是故意的。
lines.en: I pecked your shoe — not on purpose.

lines.zh: 这是我这辈子见过的好东西。
lines.en: This is the best thing I've seen.
I eat and shed spores at the same time.
I grab it and back away.

lines.zh: 那虫子是我先看见的，别动。
lines.en: I saw that bug first; leave it.
I circle, clucking.
This smells far better than mycelium.
I eat too fast and choke a little.
Is there any left in your palm?

lines.zh: 我冲过去，菌盖差点翻过来。
lines.en: I lunge and my cap nearly flips.
When I'm done I'll squat right here.
I'm waiting at your feet.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的菌盖，我愣住了。
lines.en: You step on my cap and I freeze.
My cap got knocked askew.
I hop away and spores scatter.
Don't crowd; there's barely room.
I back up into a mushroom stem.

lines.zh: 这一下，我转了两圈才站住。
lines.en: That spun me twice before I stopped.
Your foot is much harder than a stem.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，菌盖正回来了。
lines.en: I shake and my cap rights itself.
After the bump I cluck twice.
Neither of us got hurt.

lines.zh: 我张着翅膀转，孢子到处飘。
lines.en: Wings spread, I spin and spores fly.

lines.zh: 我把菌盖低下去，让她看。
lines.en: I lower my cap to show her.
We settle side by side under a toadstool.
She nudges the rim of my cap.
This patch of fungus is enough for both of us.
I cluck softly so I won't disturb her.
We preen each other a little.
It's cool under the toadstool.
She takes a step; I take half.
Two mushroom caps lean together.
I peck up a small mushroom and swallow it.
Too tough a stem; I spit it out.
I carry a grass stem away.

lines.zh: 这颗石子吞下去能磨食。
lines.en: This pebble will grind my food.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，孢子撒了一手。
lines.en: I pick it up and spores spill over my claws.
Something fell; let me look.
I tuck it beneath the mushrooms.
Useless; I kick it aside.
I hold it half a lap before letting go.
It's shiny, so I keep it.
Something's moving in the grass.

lines.zh: 我压低了身子，脖子前伸。
lines.en: I sink low and stretch my neck out.

lines.zh: 我的菌盖立起来，看起来更大。
lines.en: I raise my cap to look bigger.
It's a bug — my favourite.
I put myself in front of the flock.

lines.zh: 咯咯声变成短促的警告。
lines.en: My cluck shortens into a warning.
I'll go for its head.
I'll try a hop first.
It's backed to the edge of the mushrooms.
I won't let it through.
I close in, pecking between steps.
It circles; I'm already in the way.
I cluck and it flinches.

lines.zh: 我的孢子在它身上落了一层。
lines.en: Spores settle on it in a layer.

lines.zh: 它踩坏了一朵菌，我很生气。
lines.en: It crushed a mushroom and I'm angry.
I spread my wings and advance slowly.
It wants to flee; I hop over.
The rim of my cap is trembling.
I herd it toward the middle of the fungus.
It won't turn its back on me.

lines.zh: 我一啄，孢子跟着飞出来。
lines.en: One peck and spores burst out with it.
My claws rake its leg.
I leap and peck at its eye.
My cap rams it with a dull thud.
My wings beat until it squints.

lines.zh: 这一下轻，可正好打在关节。
lines.en: A light hit, right on the joint.
I peck three times before stopping.
I kick it with my leg.
It backs off and I follow two steps.
My call goes sharp and loud.
I squeeze out from under a mushroom cap.
My first breath tastes of mould.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，孢子撒了一地。
lines.en: I shake and spores dust the ground.

lines.zh: 这岛上全是蘑菇，我认得。
lines.en: The island's all mushrooms; I know it.
The cap weighs my head down a little.
I cluck, looking for the flock.
The fungus carpet is soft underfoot.

lines.zh: 我的影子被菌盖分成了两半。
lines.en: My shadow is split by the cap.
I look up and dew drips into my eye.

lines.zh: 我试着走了一步，有点打滑。
lines.en: I try a step and slip a bit.

lines.zh: 菌盖被烧焦了边，味道很怪。
lines.en: The edge of my cap scorches and smells wrong.

lines.zh: 我摔在菌堆上，盖都歪了。
lines.en: I land in the mushrooms and my cap goes crooked.

lines.zh: 水灌进菌盖下面，我喘不了。
lines.en: Water floods under my cap; I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 气浪把孢子全掀了起来。
lines.en: The blast throws all my spores up.
An arrow punches through my cap's rim.
Something spins inside my cap.

lines.zh: 饿得我连孢子都不长了。
lines.en: So hungry I've stopped growing spores.

lines.zh: 雷打在菌盖上，我腿都软了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my cap and my legs fold.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我带着孢子往下掉。
lines.en: Ground's gone; I fall with my spores.
